title: Dover AFB - JPED Security System
description_text: Description: Dover AFB, DE requires Security a system upgrade to the Joint Personal Effects Depots intrusion detection, access control, video surveillance, and visitor management systems to strengthen their cyber security posture while streamlining their technologies operating environment. Deliverables: Please refer to Sections L & M of the attached SF1449 for more information regarding deliverables. Site Visit: A site visit will be held on May 6, 2026 at 0900. Meet at the Dover AFB Visitor Center NLT 0845 to allow time to acquire base acces badges. Please send a list of attendees to Lt Ambrose and Ms. Barra NLT 5 May 2026 to allow for badging to occur. Questions: Questions may be submitted to the points of contact Lt Travis Ambrose travis.ambrose.1@us.af.mil and Victoria Barra victoria.barra@us.af.mil , no later than the specified date and time May 7, 2026. Questions submitted after this date and time may not be answered.
